# Evolvement of priority topics

- Close out of estimands. Background: 
  - The EML continue to consider the broad topic of estimands, and its continued embedding in drug development, very important.
  - Key is expanded and continued involvement of clinicians. The [EWIG](), situated at [EFPIA]() level, is well positioned to work towards that goal and drive it.
  - The EML continue to collaborate with the [EWIG]() on an opportunistic basis and offer our expertise on the topic.
